note: P repeats one template four times (tapered conical tube, lamp left with a control panel right, dark purple room, pink/orange wax, brass or steel cap and base). Q varies the lamp silhouette (rocket cap, bulb vessel), palette (violet, amber-dark, plum) and layout (bottom control bar vs side panel). R is a middle case: it varies the metal (brass, copper, steel), liquid colour (amber, purple, red) and control placement, but is mostly the same tapered cone with a side panel. None of the twelve break the fixed lava-lamp requirements.
